entities.summary: Mykola Georgiyovich Bagrayev is a Ukrainian businessman in the fields of media and show business and a social activist. He is best known as the founder of the Tavria Games, an international music festival, and the Chernomorki Games, a national charitable festival for children. He established the radio broadcasting group TAVR Media, and also played a key role in the creation of the Ukrainian music television channels M1 and M2. Bagrayev is a co-founder of TicketsBox, a ticket distribution platform, and has ownership interests in the advertising company RTM-Ukraine and the technical production firm Profi Group.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Mykola Bagrayev's founding of the Tavria Games and Chernomorki Games has had a significant impact on Ukrainian popular culture, with both festivals attracting thousands of attendees annually. His involvement in various media and entertainment ventures has also contributed to Ukraine's growing presence in global broadcasting.
